svg.text: Desktop App (Tauri v2 · any host · talks only to Gateway)
MQTT broker · HTTP entry · global resource authority
NodeRegistry · Intent Router · Budget Tracker · Rate Limiter · Vault · Interaction Store · Resource Cache
auto-spawned by Gateway as sibling binary · listens on :19900
loopback HTTP · direct LLM API · private Grafeo · spawned by local Node Agent
Machine B · Remote Node (any host · GPU / workstation / cloud)
executes Agents · owns their filesystem · talks to Gateway via MQTT + HTTP
enrolled via token · listens on :19900 · reverse-proxy + auth boundary for its runtimes
… N runtimes / machine · M machines / deployment …
Three principles make this a true distributed Agent platform

g.text: Gateway's local node and remote nodes run identical code. No "local vs. remote" branching in Gateway.
Runtime HTTP server binds 127.0.0.1. The Node Agent is the single auth/network-exposure boundary.
Every reachable listener publishes scheme://host:port — no implicit 127.0.0.1 stitching anywhere.
Desktop → Gateway HTTP API → intent/control plane (MQTT) → remote Node control topic
→ Node spawns/uses local Runtime → Runtime streams reply via Gateway broker → Desktop MQTT subscriber.
Bulk file queries additionally hop: Desktop → Gateway HTTP → Node reverse proxy (19900) → Runtime loopback HTTP.

svg.text: See ADR-055 for full design rationale · core/acowork-node · /api/nodes endpoints
